( c ) jīyati , jiyyati [ S. jīryati], grows old; decays, wears out; perishes ; D II 30, 26 (kicchaṃ vatāyaṃ loko āpanno, jāyati ca ~ati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca); 32, 30 (jāyetha vā ~etha vā); M III 168, 8 (pāṇā andhakāre jāyanti andhakāre ~anti andhakāre mīyanti); 246, 22 (ajāyamāno kiṃ ~issati, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se jiyyissati); S I 142, 14 (idaṃ niccaṃ idaṃ dhuvaṃ … idaṃ hi na jāyati na ~ati na mīyati); Ja III 336, 10* (dhanā pi tattha ~anti rājakoso ca vaḍḍhati; or jīyati 3 ? cf 336, 14´ foll. : tattha te vivādapannā dhanato pi jīyanti attano santakā parihāyanti); V 103, 22* (yassa raṭṭhamhi ~anti appatikā kumārikā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee raṭṭhasmiṃ jīvanti appatītā); VI 27, 24* (kiṃ dhanena yaṃ ~etha kiṃ bhariyāya marissati, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se jiyyetha; 28, 11´ : khayaṃ gaccheyya); 528, 5* (acirā cakkhūni ~are; 528, 9´ : na cirass’ eva cakkhūni ~issantī ti); Kv 41, 31 (citte citte puggalo jāyati ~ati mīyati cavati upapajjatī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se jiyyati); Peṭ 58, 11* (~ate); Mil 320, 29 (ākāso na jāyati na ~ati na mīyati); Sadd 344, 21 (je khaye: ~ati … saddasatthavidū pana jāyatī ti rūpaṃ vadanti); 593, 10 (jara vayohāniyaṃ jīrati jiyyati); — part.pr. ( a ) jīya(t), mfn. , Ja IV 398, 19* (vaṇṇaṃ jarā hanti narassa ~ato; 398, 28´ : jīramānassa narassa); ( b ) jīyamāna, jiyyamāna, mfn. , Pj I 78, 3 (paramatthato ca khandhesu jāyamānesu ~amānesu mīyamānesu ca, Be, Ce so; Ee omits mīyamānesu; Se jiyyamānesu); — neg. ajīyamāna, mfn. , M III 246, 22 (ajāyamāno kiṃ jīyissati ajīyamāno kiṃ mīyissati, Be, Ce so; Ee Se ajiyyamāno); — aor. 3 sg. jīyittha, S I 54, 17 (nandasi samaṇā ti, kiṃ laddhā āvuso ti, tena hi samaṇa socasī ti, kiṃ ~ittha āvuso ti; Spk I 112, 30 : yassa hi kiñci manāpaṃ cīvarādivatthu jiṇṇaṃ hoti so socati, Be, Se so; Ee yo hi kiñci manāpacīvarādivatthu jīno hoti; Ce jiṇṇo hoti); Ja I 468, 2* (mā me mitti ~ittha, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se bhijjittha; 468, 10´ : mama sahāyena saddhiṃ metti mā bhijjittha, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se mitti); — pr. 3 sg. ( d ) jīrati ( sometimes written jirati in Ee, Se ) [ S. jīryati], 1. grows old; wears out; decays; perishes ; Vin I 237, 34 (na ca pana te āyasmantā ~anti taṃ bhagavantaṃ asatā tucchā musā va abhūtena abbhācikkhantā, Ce, Ee so; Be jiridanti; Se kīranti) = A IV 188, 4 ( Ce, Ee, Se so; Be jiridanti; Mp IV 103, 8 foll. : abbhācikkhantā na ~anti abbhakkhānassa antaṃ na gacchantī ti attho atha vā lajjanatthe idaṃ jīrantī ti padaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ, na lajjantī ti attho, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be jiridanti … jiridantī ti); Vin II 120, 19 (jantāgharassa kuḍḍapādo ~ati); S I 43, 12* (rūpaṃ ~ati maccānaṃ nāmagottaṃ na ~ati); A III 54, 22 (sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ jarādhammaṃ ~ati); Dhp 152 (appassutāyaṃ puriso balivaddo va ~ati; cf jīrati 3 ); Ja III 38, 8* (sandhi tesaṃ na ~ati); IV 109, 12* (devā na ~anti yathā manussā); V 233, 23* (kālena yācaṃ yāceyya evaṃ mittā na ~are); 280, 13 (sace pi me sarīraṃ jiṇṇaṃ rāgo pana na ~ati); Sp 1246, 15 (sace so āvāso ~ati, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se jirati); Sv 942, 10 (vatthāni kilissanti ~anti); Dhp-a I 11, 14* (cakkhūni ~antu, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~anti); III 407, 6 (anattā ti mā ~antu mā mīyantū ti vase vattetuṃ na sakkā ti); Sadd 593, 9 (jara vayohāniyaṃ ~ati); — part.pr. ( a ) jīranta, mfn. , Ja IV 109, 23´ ; Spk I 138, 24 (rathesu ~antesu); ( b ) jīramāna, mfn. , A I 179, 22 (puttaṃ ~amānaṃ); Th 32 (Th-a I 98, 9 foll. : ~amānenā ti ~antena, khaṇe khaṇe jaraṃ pāpuṇantena); Ja IV 398, 28´ (~amānassa narassa, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se jiramānassa); V 123, 10´ (yathā naḷāgāraṃ mūlato paṭṭhāya ~amānaṃ appatiṭṭhaṃ patati); — 2. is consumed; is digested ; Ja II 362, 23 (sesaṃ ajjhohaṭamattam eva ~ati); Vism 101, 15 (bhattaṃ na ~ati); Sp 1089, 24 (na cchādentī ti na ~anti na vātarogaṃ paṭippassambhetuṃ sakkonti); Ps II 416, 16 (sabbaṃ ~atu phāsukaṃ hotū ti hatthena kucchiṃ parāmasissa); Mhv 22:76 (mā ~atu kucchigataṃ idaṃ vo ti); — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) jīri, A I 179, 23 (ahaṃ ~āmi mā me putto ~ī ti); Dhp-a I 172, 14 (cīvaraṃ ~i); III 102, 14 (tāsaṃ kucchiyaṃ surā ~i); ( b ) ajīratha, Ja VI 55, 22* (raṭṭhe vilumpamānamhi na me kiñci ajīratha, Ce, Ee so, wr ? Be ahīratha; Se ahāratha [ mistake for ahīratha?]); 3 pl. jīriṃsu, Kv 457, 16 (jarādhammā sattā mā ~iṃsu, Be so; Ee, Se jiriṃsu; Ce jiyiṃsu) ≠ 607, 29 ( Be so; Ee jariṃsu; Se jiriṃsu; Ce jiyiṃsu); — pp jiṇṇa , mfn. and m. [ S. jīrṇa], 1. ( mfn. and m. ) old; worn out; an old man ; Abh 254; Vin III 252, 20 (~āya vassikasāṭikāya); IV 278, 8 (yadā ~ā bhavissatha tadā brahmacariyaṃ carissatha); D II 22, 9 (eso kho deva ~o nāma na dāni tena ciraṃ jīvitabbaṃ bhavissatī ti); M I 82, 30 (ahaṃ … ~o vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto asītiko me vayo vattati); S I 176, 16* (asso va ~o nibbhogo khādanā apanīyati); A I 246, 29 (~o … potthako dubbaṇṇo ca hoti dukkhasamphasso ca appaggho ca); II 249, 29 (naṭṭhaṃ gavesanti ~aṃ paṭisaṅkharonti); Sn 1 (so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ urago ~am iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ); Th 73 (~aṃ ca disvā dukkhitaṃ ca vyādhitaṃ mataṃ ca disvā); Ja V 509, 22* (na te puttā ye na bharanti ~aṃ); VI 175, 25* (pabbajissāmi ~o smi na kāme abhipatthaye); 522, 12* (natthi khiḍḍā natthi rati ~ena patinā saha); Mil 224, 4 (andhe ~e mātāpitaro poseti); Vism 118, 24 (navattaṃ ~-ttaṃ); Ps II 111, 28 (paribhogena vā ~aṃ); Spk I 349, 20 (cīvarāni pi ’ssa ~āni, tato tato suttāni galanti); Pj II 313, 5 foll. (~ā ti jajjarībhūtā … api ca ~ā ti porāṇā, cirakālappavatta-kulanvayā ti vuttaṃ hoti); Th-a I 140, 4 (~-tāya); II 203, 35 (tāpasakāle katapaṇṇasālā ~ā paluggā ahosi); Mhv 35:81 (āvāse ~e ca paṭisaṅkhari); — 2. ( mfn. ) digested ; Ja I 297, 26 (pabuddho ~āya surāya, Be, Se so; Ce jiṇṇāsāya; Ee jiṇṇasayasurāya); V 14, 5 (biḷālā pi surāya ~āya uṭṭhahitvā kīḷantā vicariṃsu); — see also ajiṇṇa, ajiṇṇaka; — 3. ( n. ) old age; the being old ; — see iic below ; — jiṇṇo in Ee at S I 123, 2* is prob. wr for jīno ( Be so; Ce jito; Se jinno); — jiṇṇo in Ee at Ap 485, 20 is prob. wr for dīno ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — jiṇṇā in Ee at Peṭ 96, 2 is prob. wr for nijjiṇṇā ( Be, Ce so ); — ~-kaṭasāra, m. , an old mat ; As 180, 13 (~-kaṭasāramattena paṭicchādetvā, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se ~-kaṭasāraka-); — ~-kālasmiṃ, ~-kāle, in old age; when one is old ; Ja I 308, 29 (puttehi ~-kāle mātāpitaro paṭijaggitabbā); VI 252, 7´ (~-kālasmiṃ hi te tāni kammāni kātuṃ na sakkonti); Spk I 261, 28 (so asso evaṃ ~-kāle … nibbhogo); — ~-gharaka, n. , an old house ; As 120, 28 (~-gharakaṃ … tiṭṭhati, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se jiṇṇagharaṃ); — ~-cīvaraka, ~-cīvarika, mfn. , whose robes are old or worn-out ; Ja II 25, 11 (thero … pañca sāṭakasatāni ~-cīvarakānaṃ adāsi, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be ~-cīvarikānaṃ); Mp I 232, 18 (eko ~-cīvariko paccekabuddho); Dhp-a I 219, 8 (sesāni ~-cīvarakānaṃ dassāmi, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce ~-cīvarikānaṃ); — ~-tara, mfn. , older ; Ja IV 108, 24* (~ā si ajja); — ~-taracīvara, mfn. , whose robes are older ; Dhp-a I 219, 10 (~-taracīvarānaṃ, Ee so; Be, Ce ~-taracīvarikānaṃ; Se ~-taracīvarakānaṃ); — ~-paṭisaṅkharaṇa, n. , repairing what is old or worn-out ; Ja V 429, 18 (~-paṭisaṅkharaṇaṃ karoti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~-paṭisaṅkhāraṇaṃ); Ps IV 150, 27 ; — ~-paṭi-saṅkhāraka, mfn. , (one) who repairs what is old or worn-ou t; Ja V 429, 13 (rājanivesane ~-paṭisaṅkhārako eko caṇḍālo); — atijiṇṇa, mfn. , very old; too old ; Sv 568, 13 (nātitaruṇassa nātijiṇṇassa ekajeṭṭhaka-sūkarassa); — sujiṇṇa, mfn. , properly worn-out; legitimately worn-out ; Sp 1248, 11 (saṅghikaparibhogena paribhuñjantassa … jiṇṇaṃ sujiṇṇaṃ); — fpp ajeyya 2 , mfn. , imperishable ; Ja VI 323, 16* (ajjeyya-m-esā tava hotu mettī; 323, 20´ : esā … piyasaṃvāsamettī ajeyyā hotu); — caus. pr. 3 sg. ( a ) jarayati [ S. jarayati], wears out, breaks up; makes perish ; Ja V 501, 14* (na tena mittiṃ ~ayetha pañño, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se jirayetha; 501, 19´ : na ~ayetha na vināseyya, Ce, Ee so; Be na jīrayetha; Se na jirayetha) = VI 375, 22* ( Ce so; Be mettiṃ ~ayetha; Ee mittaṃ ~ayetha; Se mettiṃ jirayetha; 375, 25´ foll. : mittabhāvaṃ nāma na jīreyya na nāseyyā ti attho, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se jaheyya); Vv-a 35, 6 (kuṃ vā paṭhaviṃ … ~ayatī ti kuñjaro; ≠ Pv-a 57, 24 : jīrayati); — ( b ) jīreti , jīrayati , 1. wears out, breaks up; makes perish ; Pv-a 57, 24 (kuñjarenā ti kuṃ paṭhaviṃ ~ayati); Ja VI 375, 26´ (na ~eyya na nāseyyā ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se jaheyya); — 2. digests ; Ja I 274, 19 (taṃ āvudhaṃ ~etuṃ na sakkhissasi, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se jīrāpetuṃ); 274, 25 (maṃsakhaṇḍaṃ mayhaṃ kucchi ~etuṃ na sakkhissati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se kucchiṃ jīrāpetuṃ); — ( c ) jīrāpeti , 1. wears out; makes perish, brings to an end ; Sp 352, 15 (paribhuñjanto ~eti); Mp I 264, 9 (tvaṃ pubbe katakammaṃ yāvajjadivasā ~etuṃ na sakkosi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee jirāpetuṃ); II 156, 26 (iṇaṃ ~emī ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~essāmī tī); Thī-a 247, 35 (nijjaressāmī ti ~essāmi vināsessāmi); — part.pr. jīrāpenta, mfn. , Ps II 271, 13 (uṭṭhāy’ uṭṭhāya dukkham eva ~entā āhiṇḍathā ti); — 2. digests ; Ja III 314, 7´ (ettakaṃ bhuñjitvā ~etuṃ sakkhissāmī ti); VI 581, 10 (Jūjako pi pamāṇātikkantaṃ bhuñjitvā ~etuṃ asakkonto tatth’ eva kālam akāsi); As 404, 10 (~etuṃ); — neg. absol. ajīrāpetvā, not having used up ;? before using up ;? Ja II 309, 10 (ekassa hatthato bhatiṃ gahetvā taṃ ajīrāpetvā aññassa hatthato na gaṇhāti); 381, 5 (ahaṃ gahitabhatiṃ ajīrāpetvā va aññena diyyamānāya bhatiyā hatthaṃ pasāresiṃ); — ( d ) jāpayati , makes perish; brings to an end ; Ja VI 108, 8* (ye keci pūgāya dhanassa hetu sakkhiṃ karitvā iṇaṃ ~ayanti; 108, 19´ foll. : taṃ dhanaṃ yathāruciṃ khāditvā … asukaṭṭhāne amhehi ettakaṃ dinnan ti kūṭasakkhiṃ datvā taṃ iṇaṃ ~ayanti vināsenti); — absol. jāpayitvā, Ja VI 108, 9* (te ~ayitvā janataṃ); — caus. pass. pr. 3 sg. jīrīyati , jirī̆yati (jīrati), jarīyati [ S. *jaryate?], is made old; is made to wear out ; ( or to jarati 2 qv ); M I 188, 7 (ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo … yena ca santappati yena ca ~ati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, Be so; Ce jirīyati; Ee jiriyati; Se jīrati; Ps II 227, 34 : yena ayaṃ kāyo jīrati indriyavekallataṃ balaparikkhayaṃ valitapalitādi-bhāvaṃ ca pāpuṇāti) = III 241, 15 ( Be, Ce so; Se jiriyati; Ee wr janīyati) ≠ Vibh 83, 28 ( Be, Ce ~ati; Ee jīrate; Se jīrati; Vibh-a 69, 19 : yena ayaṃ kāyo ~ati) quoted Ps I 30, 20 ( Be ~ati; Ce, Ee jarīyati; Se jīriyyati) ≠ Vism 363, 8 ( Be ~ati; Ce jirīyati; Ee jīrayati; Se jariyati); Sadd 593, 14 (yena tejogatena kupitena ayaṃ kāyo ekāhikādi-jararogena jarīyati jarati, atha vā yena ca jarīyati yena ayaṃ kāyo jīrati indriyavekalyaṃ balakkhayaṃ palitavalitādiṃ ca pāpuṇāti); — pp jarita , mfn. [ ts ], aged; old ; Ap 609, 8 (tiss’ itthiyo nidassesi iddhiyā … taruṇiṃ ~aṃ mataṃ, Be, Ce so; Se jarikaṃ; Ee taruṇī ~ā matā); — neg. ajarita, mfn. , Spk III 112, 9 (jarāya ajaritattā ajajjaraṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ajajjaritattā); — see also jarati 2 .
NCP: jiyyati 1 pass. pr. 3 sg. jiyyati 2 pr. 3 sg. See also: jīyati, jīyati
